mechanism: In V8's documented Orinoco design, surviving objects may move within or between generations; old-generation compaction reduces fragmentation and requires pointer updates.
why: Generational collection concentrates work on short-lived objects; compaction packs surviving objects together.
useWhen: Studying V8's 2016-2019 Orinoco design. These are implementation descriptions, not a promise about every engine or future V8 release.
price: Moving survivors costs copying and pointer updates. Parallel collection reduces some pauses but does not make collection free.
syntaxExample: No JavaScript syntax selects this collector design; it belongs to the engine implementation.

empowered_by.how: Copies surviving objects and updates pointers to their new locations.
empowered_by.forCase: Moving collection in the documented Orinoco design.
